propositions: Bridge is hard-wired to a single tracker project at three points (JiraConfig scalar, fetcher JQL construction, applier cross-project guard) and cannot handle teams running multiple projects against one codebase or multiple repos against one store
A shared ticket store with store-owned project-to-repos mapping eliminates divergence between repos fetching different project subsets against a shared prev_snapshot.json

Ticket project field must be tri-state (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit-key=sync there) to enable zero-event migration of existing stores by resolving against a store-recorded legacy default

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate configured projects for base JQL AND all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results keyed by issue to preserve enrichment fidelity across projects
Outbound dispatch must read per-ticket project on create and relax cross-project guard from single project to set membership; empty-project tickets produce no mutation

Store-compat capability stamp must atomically commit both the mapping mutation and the re-derived required_capabilities entry in one tracker commit, and binary lacking multi-project-bridge must refuse writes to multi-project stores
